phases.label: CORE
phases.name: Core plumbing
phases.description: Ingest, retry, and config schema work.

tickets.title: Wire the ingest retry queue
tickets.description: Add a bounded retry queue in front of the ingest worker so a transient failure does not drop the payload.

issues.title: Retry queue drops the final byte of a chunked payload
issues.impact: Confirmed to drop the tail byte of a chunked payload under concurrent retries; actionable now.

issues.title: Flag parser mishandles café, señor, and 🎉 in --page values
issues.impact: Reproducible with storybloq ticket list --page café; the parser should reject non-numeric input cleanly instead of throwing.

issues.title: Snapshot pruning may keep stale entries under clock skew
issues.impact: OWNER-GATED: pending a decision on the retention policy before any fix lands; do not treat as actionable yet.
